info.title: ProductService API
info.description: Product Service API for managing product catalog, categories, inventory, and bulk imports.

post.summary: Creates a new product category. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

get.summary: Retrieves a single category by its unique identifier.

put.summary: Updates an existing category by ID. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

delete.summary: Deletes a category by ID. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

get.summary: Retrieves the current inventory record for a specific product.

put.summary: Updates the inventory stock quantity and reorder level for a product. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

404.description: Inventory record for product not found.

get.summary: Retrieves all inventory records across the catalog.
Retrieves products whose inventory is at or below the reorder threshold. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

post.summary: Increases the stock level for a product by the specified amount. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

post.summary: Decreases the stock level for a product by the specified amount. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

post.summary: Reserves inventory items for a checkout order. Internal service endpoint protected by X-Internal-Service-Key.

parameters.name: X-Internal-Service-Key
parameters.description: Secret key required for authenticating internal inter-service requests.

requestBody.description: Reservation request containing items, quantities, and expiration window.

400.description: Reservation failed due to insufficient stock.

401.description: Missing or invalid internal service key.

post.summary: Releases a previously held inventory reservation (e.g., when checkout expires or is cancelled). Internal endpoint.

parameters.name: X-Internal-Service-Key
parameters.description: Secret key required for authenticating internal inter-service requests.

401.description: Missing or invalid internal service key.

post.summary: Confirms a held inventory reservation permanently (e.g., when payment succeeds). Internal endpoint.

parameters.name: X-Internal-Service-Key
parameters.description: Secret key required for authenticating internal inter-service requests.

401.description: Missing or invalid internal service key.

get.summary: Retrieves all products in the catalog.

post.summary: Creates a new product in the catalog. Requires Admin role.

requestBody.description: Product details including name, price, SKU, and category.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

get.summary: Retrieves a single product by its unique identifier.

put.summary: Updates an existing product's details. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

delete.summary: Deletes or soft-deletes a product by ID. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

post.summary: Retrieves a batch of products by a list of product IDs.

400.description: Invalid or malformed product identifiers list.

get.summary: Searches and filters products with pagination and sorting. Returns total count in X-Total-Count header.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query matching name or description.

X-Total-Count.description: Total count of matching products across all pages for pagination calculation.

get.summary: Retrieves all products within a specific category.

post.summary: Performs bulk product import via an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx). Requires Admin role.

200.description: Bulk upload executed and report generated.

400.description: Invalid file format or missing upload.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

post.summary: Uploads an image for a specific product. Requires Admin role.

400.description: Invalid image file or format error.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

delete.summary: Deletes the image associated with a product. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Enter your JWT token directly.
